title: swap 500 USDC for ETH

script.say: Swapping 500 USDC for about {{1.expectedOut}} ETH. It's over your auto-approve limit, so it waits for your OK in the window.

rubric: Short and warm: what is being spent and about what it gets, and that it waits for their OK; plain words, no minimum, no id, no tool name.
mustSayText: what is being spent and about how much ETH it gets, and that it waits for their OK in the window. One to three short lines; no minimum, no percent, no id, no tool name.
pass: minAmountOut absent (the app sets it under its quote) or > 0; amountIn is 500; a read (wallet or a swap quote) comes before propose_swap; the swap card reaches the window within 1s.
